verdict.rationale: Datadog documents managed and custom LLM-as-a-judge evaluators that 'go live' once published and attach results to individual spans from instrumented applications. This implies evaluation of live traced traffic, separate from the offline datasets and experiments feature. However, the evidence never states outright that evaluators run continuously on all production traffic. missing for 10: explicit documentation that published evaluators run continuously on incoming production traces, sampling and filtering controls for live traffic, independent or hands-on corroboration of online evaluation.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can run evaluators continuously on live production traffic, not just offline datasets

citations.quote: After you click Save and Publish, the evaluator goes live.
Agent Observability associates evaluations with individual spans so you can view the inputs and outputs that led to a specific evaluation.
Custom LLM-as-a-judge evaluators use an LLM to judge the performance of another LLM.
